name: JoAi: Show Subscription

description.en: Get details of a specific subscription, including status, renewal date, contact, and delivery profile.
description.de: Zeige Details eines bestimmten Abonnements mit Status, Verlängerungsdatum, Kontakt und Lieferprofil an.
description.fr: Obtenez les détails d'un abonnement, y compris le statut, la date de renouvellement, le contact et le profil de livraison.
description.es: Obtén los detalles de una suscripción, incluidos estado, fecha de renovación, contacto y perfil de entrega.
description.it: Ottieni i dettagli di un abbonamento, inclusi stato, data di rinnovo, contatto e profilo di consegna.
description.ro: Obține detaliile unui abonament, inclusiv status, data reînnoirii, contactul și profilul de livrare.

bot: Use this when the user wants details about a specific subscription. If they refer to a subscription by customer or product, list subscriptions first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Subscription ID

description.en: The hashid of the subscription to show
description.fr: Le hashid de l'abonnement à afficher
description.es: El hashid de la suscripción a consultar

inputs.bot: The subscription hash ID. If the user refers to a subscription by customer or product, list subscriptions first to find the matching ID.

inputs.name: Team

description.en: Team slug for this action. Defaults to the current team.
description.de: Team-Slug für diese Aktion. Standardmäßig das aktuelle Team.
description.fr: Slug d'équipe pour cette action. Par défaut l'équipe actuelle.
description.es: Slug del equipo para esta acción. Por defecto el equipo actual.
description.it: Slug del team per questa azione. Predefinito: team attuale.
description.ro: Slug-ul echipei pentru această acțiune. Implicit echipa curentă.

inputs.bot: The slug of the team to operate on. Omit to use the current team.
